clips.title: The story
paras: Doctor Draxlegauge hands you the elven gems and sends you to carry them to Captain O'Breen. After a few weeks among pirates, he and the professor know that holding on to their treasure is unhealthy.

Doctor Draxlegauge does not want Captain O'Breen kept waiting, since the captain will want to see the elven gems for himself. After weeks among these pirates, the doctor and the professor have learned that being caught holding on to pirate treasure is bad for their health. He hands you the gems to carry to O'Breen, who waits at the bridge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Let's not leave Captain O'Breen waiting. He'll want to see these gems first hand. After all, that's why we're here!
And after a few weeks of consorting with these pirates, the professor and I have realized the last thing that's good for our health is to be caught hanging on to their treasure.
Here, friend, take these to O'Breen.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ahoy, adventurer. What brings you to the bridge?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So the little gnomes proved their worth after all? I knew we kept those ankle biters around for a reason!
